# Copilot instructions

- Follow `docs/spec.md` and `TODO.md`; run existing checks before editing.
- Use vertical red/green TDD, testing browser behavior and the public catalog interface.
- Keep the implementation plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Do not add a framework or backend.
- Keep recommendations manually curated. Each populated category has exactly three sourced picks; omissions require a reason.
- Render content and search queries as text, validate resource links, and verify project-prefix paths.
- Preserve tests and unrelated files. Review changes, test evidence, and public content before deployment.
